items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: And he gave me a time, man.

ctx.x: How long was the 3 Pences gig?

It was long. I have no idea how long but I know I had a tough time there. I had a pretty rough time at the 3 Pences. Came when we landed there, Ben Webster had his little 4-piece group, and he had a guitar player named Ted Walters. And he gave me a time, man. Because he was well-seasoned, and I had been playing not even two years. And he really gave me a time. Look like I made more mistakes than I ever made in my whole life, you know. Butterflies in your stomach, or whatever you want to call it. Because we were…
Was Ben Webster playing the club at the same time?
